scriptLines: query: 'SELECT a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk, p.paciente_key, dep.departamento_key, dg.diagnostico_key, CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.admission_date, 112)) AS fecha_ingreso_key, CASE WHEN a.discharge_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.discharge_date, 112)) END AS fecha_alta_key, a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id, CASE WHEN a.discharge_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATEDIFF(DAY, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date) END AS dias_estancia, 1 AS conteo_admisiones FROM silver.admissions a INNER JOIN gold.dim_paciente p ON p.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id INNER JOIN gold.dim_departamento dep ON dep.nombre_departamento = LTRIM(RTRIM(a.department)) CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) LTRIM(RTRIM(d.icd_code)) AS codigo_icd, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.diagnosis_description)), \'\') AS descripcion_patologia, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.severity)), \'\'), \'No especificado\') AS nivel_severidad FROM silver.diagnoses d WHERE d.admission_id = a.admission_id ORDER BY d.diagnosis_id) d1 INNER JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico dg ON dg.codigo_icd = d1.codigo_icd AND (dg.descripcion_patologia = d1.descripcion_patologia OR (dg.descripcion_patologia IS NULL AND d1.descripcion_patologia IS NULL)) AND dg.nivel_severidad = d1.nivel_severidad INNER JOIN gold.dim_fecha fi ON fi.fecha_key = CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.admission_date, 112)) LEFT JOIN gold.dim_fecha fa ON fa.fecha_key = CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), a.discharge_date, 112)) WHERE a.discharge_date IS NULL OR fa.fecha_key IS NOT NULL',
